idea-plugin.name: WCAG 2.2 CSS Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Reads your stylesheet and names the success criterion each rule breaks, including the three WCAG 2.2 added that WCAG 2.1 linters never learned.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → WCAG 2.2 CSS Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 14 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/wcag22-css-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/wcag22-css-lint

action.text: WCAG 2.2 CSS Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run WCAG 2.2 CSS Lint on the file in the editor
